**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES** · 2 blockers · 0 important · 0 nits · head `82d96806`

- **blocker:** the PR description has no `fails without the fix:` line naming the test that fails without the fix. Please add one, for example `fails without the fix: contentExtractor.test.ts › captionImagesWithGemini — Vertex AI provider › <the default-model test>`, plus a test for the location below.

<details><summary>Scope</summary>

I read the diff and the Vertex request path (`contentExtractor.ts` around lines 376–420). I checked the model id against Google's model pages ([model versions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/model-versions), [3.1 Flash-Lite](https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/models/gemini/3-1-flash-lite)). `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` is listed as GA, released 2026-05-07, with retirement no earlier than 2027-05-07. `gemini-2.5-flash` retired on 2026-10-20, as the PR says. I did not call Vertex itself because I have no GCP credentials. I didn't wait for CI because this is a request-changes verdict.
</details>

review_comments.body: **blocker:** with this default, the id won't resolve at the default location. Google's page lists `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` only on `global` and the `us`/`eu` multi-regions, with no single region. The client below still defaults to `location: process.env.HYPERFRAMES_VERTEX_LOCATION || "us-central1"` (around line 394). So the setup this PR targets (`HYPERFRAMES_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID` and `HYPERFRAMES_VERTEX_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` set, no location) still sends every caption request to a model us-central1 doesn't serve. Captioning keeps failing, now with a not-found error instead of a retired-model error. Default the location to `"global"`, and pin the location the client is built with in the Vertex default test. `@google/genai` accepts `global`.
